subject: Redwood eval kickoff — scheduling and success criteria
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Halpert <sara.halpert@acme.com>, James Li <james.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood eval kickoff — scheduling and success criteria

Hi Sara / James,

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about Acme's search & recommendations pilot. Quick recap and suggested next steps:  

- Goal: validate latency and relevance for your 1M-doc corpus and confirm embedding/retrieval config.
- Success criteria (proposal): 95th pctile latency < 120ms for small queries, NDCG@10 improvement > 15% vs current baseline, and stable token cost under projected QPS.
- Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (45–60m) where we run through the trial plan, align on prompt sets/evals, and confirm infrastructure (sample data, VPN access or S3).

Marissa (CS) and Dev (SE) are looped in to run the technical kickoff and own the eval plan. Do any of these times on Thursday/Friday work for you?  

- Thu 6/17, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 6/17, 15:00–15:45 PT (shorter slot, demo + plan)
- Fri 6/18, 9:00–10:00 PT

I'll attach a short eval plan + demo agenda we can update once we confirm the attendees. If you prefer a calendar invite, I can send one.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-eval-plan.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pptx

From: Sara Halpert <sara.halpert@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Li <james.li@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood eval kickoff — scheduling and success criteria

Connor — thanks for the recap and for looping Marissa/Dev in. Those high-level success criteria look aligned with what the execs care about. A couple quick notes:  

- On latency: our internal SLO is 150ms p95 for the product experience, so your 120ms target is good.
- For relevance: we have a labeled holdout of ~2k queries for NDCG measurement. Happy to share sample keys.
- Data access: James will reach out separately on what access we can provide (S3 or temporary DB read).

For timing, Thu 6/17 10:00–11:00 PT works for me and I'll block the slot. Can you include a brief agenda and list of technical attendees we should have on our side?

Thanks,
Sara Halpert
Sr. PM, Search
Acme Corp
sara.halpert@acme.com

---

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood eval kickoff — scheduling and success criteria

Great — thanks Sara, I've penciled in Thu 6/17 10:00–11:00 PT. Sending a calendar invite now.  

Draft agenda for the kickoff (attached and below):
- 10m: Introductions + objectives
- 15m: Demo of Redwood integration patterns (embedding + retrieval, batching)
- 20m: Review eval plan & success criteria (data access, measurement, timeline)
- 10m: Next steps / ownership / calendar alignment

Marissa / Dev — for the kickoff could you prepare:
- A short checklist of data artifacts we'll need (sample S3 path, API keys, schema).
- A minimal prompt set template we can use for the NDCG tests (5–10 queries + ramp plan).
- Proposed staging infra (private tenant vs hosted demo environment).

I've attached the eval plan PDF and demo agenda PPTX; we'll update after the kickoff. If any constraints on sharing the holdout queries let me know and we'll work with an obfuscated sample instead.

Connor

Attachment: redwood-eval-plan.pdf
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pptx

From: James Li <james.li@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Sara Halpert <sara.halpert@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood eval kickoff — scheduling and success criteria

Thanks — invite received and accepted. Attendees from our side: myself, one infra engineer (Priya), and a data scientist (Liam). We'll aim to have an S3 staging bucket ready with a 10k document sample and the 2k labeled holdout.

A couple asks for the kickoff so we can come prepared:  
- Could you send a short template of the prompt set (anonymized) and the eval metrics you plan to run? If possible, a single CSV with columns: query, expected_ids, metric_tag.
- Any requirements for network/firewall or VPN access for the staging tenant?

If you can drop the prompt template and a checklist in the calendar invite or Drive link before the call that would be ideal. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
James Li
Staff Engineer, Search
Acme Corp
james.li@acme.com
